saveAgentFirst: Save the Grok Bot agent before connecting it.
intro: Runs in Grok Bot. The Bot retains its apps and persistent context. Paperclip supplies task coordination and first-party tools. Usage and spending are not reported.
enableHint: Enable Grok Bot and Paperclip Runner on an authenticated public HTTPS instance.
roundTripRequired: Assignments require a verified routine round trip.
deliveryRejected: The routine rejected this delivery. Check the routine in Grok before retrying.
enableAssignmentsDescription: Ask the Bot for a Webhook URL navigation link if clicking its routine does nothing.
reconnectDescription: Complete OAuth in the browser. Keep this code out of Bot chat.
pairingCodeHint: Copy this code into Paperclip’s authorization page. Keep it out of Bot chat.
workingInSession: Working in a Paperclip work session
stopWorkHint: Revokes this session’s Paperclip authority and stops future dispatch. Remote execution may continue. Open Grok Bot to inspect it.
recoveryDescription: Paperclip cannot determine whether Grok is still working. Open Grok Bot, inspect this Bot and stop the old work before clearing the hold. The session must be stopped in Paperclip too.
inspectedConfirmation: I inspected Grok and resolved the old work.
clearRecoveryHint: This records your inspection. It does not confirm remote termination. Verify the routine again before new work.
